name: http-extraction-fundamentals
description: The vocabulary of extracting entities from HTTP traffic: HttpResponseKind / UrlMatch / HttpResponse (how one response is recognized and decoded into resources), Extraction (routeTo / recognize / parseWith over archived responses), SourceDescriptor (a source package's name/display/kinds as one value), and Specificity (the cross-source tiers routing ranks a claim by). Pure — no DOM, no fs, no React, and no dependency on any slice; the collector runs this vocabulary live and the HAR importer runs it over archives, and both build on this package, never the reverse.
